allowedAnchors.label: upward multiplying
allowedAnchors.text: Upward multiplying is the practice of contributing intelligently under a leader who may diminish others. It uses preparation, boundaries, questions, and evidence to keep work moving without escalating every interaction into a fight. Readers gain agency without magical thinking. They cannot force a Diminisher to transform, but they can change how they present work, request space, and protect their own thinking.
